utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Good afternoon. The registry, please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. It's the Case Number IT-03-72-A, the Prosecutor versus Milan Babic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Thank you. May I have appearances, please, the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. TRACOL
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, good afternoon, Your Honour. Susan Grogan and myself, Xavier Tracol, on behalf of the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: May I have the appearances for the Defence, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUELLER
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Madam. Peter Martin Mueller from Munich, Germany as counsel for Mr. Babic. I would like to ask apologies for any delays this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Thank you. Yes, I was wondering if you were available, but at last you are here.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUELLER
utterances.text: I was here. I just had to dress up a little bit.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: It's a complicated profession. Yes, I'd like to find out from Mr. Babic whether he can hear the proceedings in a language he understands. Mr. Babic.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone, please.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Thank you. This is a Status Conference under the provisions of Rule 65 bis, paragraph B, where a Chamber is required to hold a Status Conference for any person who is in detention, in this case awaiting an appeal. This is to allow the appellant to express concerns relating to the appeal or the detention conditions or the health of the appellant, and also to update the appellant with respect to the status of the appeal. The last Status Conference was held on the 17th of December, 2004. We are holding this Status Conference a little too earlier simply because the appeal is ready for hearing and the scheduling order has already been issued and the appeal hearing will be held on the 25th of April this year in the morning, has the parties have already been informed. I would like to find out from Mr. Babic as to whether he has concerns that you would like to raise. Before he does that, I would like to inform him that following the matters that were raised during the last Status Conference corning his family, the Appeals Chamber did request the registrar to file a report on the status of the family of the appellant and the registrar did on the 3rd of March file the report. So that the Appeals Chamber Judges are aware of what is happening. The report so filed is under confidential cover so it can be discussed and there is no need to discuss it except to inform the appellant that the Appeals Chamber is aware of what is going on. I would like to ask the Prosecution whether there are any matters they wish to raise specifically in this Status Conference.

utterances.speaker: MR. TRACOL
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, Your Honour. Nothing to say. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes. I'll go back to Mr. Babic since I had asked him whether there were any matters he wishes to discuss concerning the detention conditions, his health, or any other matters indeed.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honour. The only thing that I would like to say is to add a comment to the report that you mentioned a moment ago, but I would like us to go into closed session for that, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Very well. Yes, Counsel.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUELLER
utterances.text: I'm sorry, Your Honour. If the client does this I wonder whether it would be advisable to go in closed session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUELLER
utterances.text: Because the content of the report -- if he talks about the content of the report, then it's perhaps to do so.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes, if --

utterances.speaker: MR. MUELLER
utterances.text: If you agree, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes. I'll allow the appellant to do so, and we shall move into closed session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We are in open session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes. The appellant has indicated that there is nothing else to raise, and the Defence counsel has also indicated that there is nothing else to raise. All the pleadings are now closed and as I said the appeal hearing will be held on the 25th of April this year in the morning. So there being no other business, the Status Conference is closed and the court will rise.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: adjourned at 4.12 p.m.
